### Contact Details (e.g. Tox ID or email)

_No response_

### qTox Version

1.18.2

### Commit Hash

ac1a16ec0bb7ef1f9bbd494a076e661b05937d08

### Toxcore Version

0.2.20

### Qt Version

6.8.1

### Steps to reproduce

Open Tox, loading into the desired account, set proxy settings and close the program, then reopen it
It usually says "Couldnt load this profile" and "This Profile is already in use" which usually requires me to kill the process before reopen it


using current Debian 12, up to date

### Observed Behavior

All settings, including proxy, chat disable settings and others are not getting saved when closing qtox and opening it again


### Expected Behavior

Settings should be saved, reopen should be possible without the need to kill the process

### Reproducibility

Always

### Operating System

Linux

### Operating System version/distro/name/etc.

Debian 12

comment_data.body:
Its seems to not work on Debian 13... UI with wayland is broken, X11  works though.

Settings still do not save here

I have checked this behaviour on Debian 13.  By default, when the qTox is closed, it is not being terminated, but its window should be minimized to tray, That what has happened on LXDE. @merySweet1997 do you see the qTox icon after closing application? What desktop manager are you using?
The settings are saved on exit from qTox and if the application was not properly terminated, they are not being saved.
The tray behaviour can be changed in the **General** tab in the settings. If **Show system tray** icon is unchecked, qTox will exit when the window will be closed and the settings will be saved.

Hi. I can confirm here settings are not saved.

Closing qtox and re-opening qtox all settings back to default.

Voidlinux
qTox-v1.18.4-rc.1-x86_64.AppImage

It seems to be related to the first initialization and the next reboot. This is the 3rd reboot now, and the settings are still holding.  

Well 4th reboot now. 2 latest reboot are holding settings

Hi,
I am testing qTox v1.18.4-x86_64.AppImage.

Steps to reproduce:

1- Delete the current profile
2- Create a new profile
3- Change some settings
4- Close qTox
5- Re-launch qTox

Observed behavior:

Settings are not being saved.
After repeating steps 3–5 multiple times, the settings only persist after sending a friend request.

On my end, the settings did not hold until I sent a friend request.

labels.description: Bug fix for the user, not a fix to a build script
labels.name: bug

title: [Bug]: Settings not saved after reopen program
